PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 15, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Alvaro Castillo, Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Michele Ware, Vice Chair  Griselda Suarez, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner  Jane Templin, Commissioner
Todd Lemmis, Commissioner

  PLANNING COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS
  TO PLANNINGCOMMISSIONERS@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION OR BY PRESSING *9 ON YOUR PHONE

  TO JOIN VIA ZOOM, PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 934 1096 4133
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93410964133

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54044  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54045  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, December 18, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54046  Recommendation to accept Statutory Exemption SE-25-130;

  Recommend City Council approve the applicant’s “Other Alternative Compliance

  Page 1 of 3
   PLANNING COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JANUARY 15, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

  Method” request pursuant to Section 21.67.080.C of the Zoning Regulations to
  allow thirty-eight (38) Moderate-Income (MI) level affordable units (23 percent MI
  affordability) instead of the standard requirement of eighteen (18) Very-Low-
  Income (VLI) level affordable units (11percent VLI affordability) as required by the
  City’s Inclusionary Housing Ordinance; and

  Approve a Site Plan Review (SPR24-007), and adopt the proposed findings and
  conditions of approval related thereto, for the demolition of an existing 9,000-
  square-foot, single-story multi-tenant commercial building with surface parking to
  construct a new seven (7) story, 85-foot tall, 215,628-square-foot mixed-use
  development consisting of 161 residential units (thirty-eight [38] of which are
  affordable units [Moderate Income level]), 6,556 square feet of ground-level
  commercial space, 91 parking spaces, and 106 bicycle parking stalls on a 1.03-
  acre site located at 400 East Anaheim Street in the Community R-4-N District
  (CCN) Zoning District. Per California Government Code Section 65589.5 (Senate
  Bill 330), the project is utilizing the Downtown Plan Planned Development District
  (PD-30) development standards based on the City’s determination of Zoning and
  Land Use compatibility with the Transit Oriented Development-Moderate (TOD-M)
  PlaceType of the General Plan. (District 6)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Planning Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101
or cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
